prompt:
Full clean repaint of the USER-SELECTED CLOUD-COLLAR CHARACTER in IMAGE1, including one mandatory scroll correction. IMAGE2 is the project's gem-icon drawing reference ONLY: confident ink outline, few coherent broad painted value planes and low-gloss color. Do not import the gem's blue color or literal crystal material.

MANDATORY LOCAL STRUCTURAL FIX:
Remove the unwanted BLACK CURVED HORIZONTAL SEAM ACROSS THE INTERIOR OF THE LEFT SCROLL FACE. It runs from beside the left roller at approximately (220,440) toward behind her hair/raised arm around (380,430), dividing the upper landscape paper from lower blank paper. This INTERNAL LINE MUST DISAPPEAR. Repaint continuous ivory paper and broad pale-gray ink mountain/cloud wash across its former location, so that the left roller unrolls ONE uninterrupted paper surface into the large upper arc. Keep the genuine outside outline, roller, gold end caps, lower outer paper edge and character arm/sleeve contour. The right scroll turn/back and right roller remain intact.

DESIGN LOCK — exact image1, not earlier alternatives:
Keep same ADULT character, teal bob and broad white forelock, identical hair ornament/flower pin, gentle slightly lowered three-quarter LEFT face, actual head/body proportions, one hand near chin and opposite hand holding brush to right, pose and legs. Keep the selected rounded BLACK CLOUD SHOULDER with broad IVORY SCALLOPED EDGE and small gold collar fastener, softly curved ivory chest facing, plain black waist sash with ONE OVAL JADE CLASP, rounded ivory-lined cuffs, CURVED WRAP SKIRT and crescent-like ivory underlap, broad rounded jade-teal tails with large cloud motifs. Preserve original colors, garment cut and coverage. Do not change to diagonal-wrap costume, rectangular buckle, square shoulder or new hairstyle.

REPAINT THE WHOLE ARTWORK:
Re-establish clean confident dark contours, smooth intentional curves with a few decisive fold turns, and 2–3 LARGE COHERENT matte color/value shapes per material. Hair = few broad teal locks with continuous darker side shapes and restrained light face. Robe/cuffs/teal tails = clear attached cloth volume with few big folds. Scroll landscape = broad gray ink-mountain washes and two simple birds, no dense scenery. Rollers, brush shaft and bristle mass remain structurally coherent and simplified. Face remains soft and attractive, no polygon shards on skin.
Bring the entire selected design into a consistent polished project-icon finish. Avoid noisy triangular tessellation, hundreds of small facets, grain, speckles, elaborate brush texture, airbrushed gloss or delicate realistic hair strands. Large quiet areas and readable silhouette; no literal gemstone body.
One complete full-body square image on uniform warm ivory background, all scroll/brush/boots inside safe margins, no new props, text, frame or watermark. The finished image must have NO interior black stripe crossing the left scroll paper.
purpose: Selected cloud-collar costume: remove left scroll interior seam and repaint the complete design in a consistent clean project-icon finish.
visual_review: Left scroll interior black seam removed; continuous ivory landscape paper restored. Selected cloud shoulder, oval jade clasp, curved wrap skirt, rounded teal tails, original pose and hair retained in full repaint.
